source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to the reproductive systems (PDF 73).

blocks.text: Aap jante hain ke reproduction (tolid) ka matlab hai kisi jandar ki apni hi qism ki nayi aulad (offspring) paida karne ki salahiyat. Is chapter mein hum insan ke reproductive system (tolidi nizam) ko tafseel se parhenge.

Reproductive systems ke kaam yeh hain: reproductive cells (gametes) banana aur gametes ko fertilization (nar aur mada gamete ke milap) ke liye tayyar karna. Is ke ilawa mardana reproductive system gametes ko zanana reproductive system tak pohanchata hai, aur zanana reproductive system fertilized anday (egg cell) ko ghiza deta hai aur use bachche mein badalne ke liye munasib mahol deta hai.

blocks.title: For Information: reproductive system kaise mukhtalif hai
blocks.text:
Insan ka reproductive system doosre organ systems se do baaton mein mukhtalif hai:
i. Reproductive system mard aur aurat mein kaafi mukhtalif hota hai, jabke baqi organ systems dono mein taqreeban ek jaise hain.
ii. Reproductive system puberty (balooghat) se pehle kaam nahin karta, jabke baqi tamam systems paidaish se ya paidaish ke foran baad kaam karne lagte hain.

blocks.prompt: Do kaam batayein jo sirf zanana reproductive system karta hai.
blocks.explanation: Yeh fertilized anday ko ghiza (nourishment) deta hai, aur use bachche mein nashonuma pane ke liye mahol deta hai.

items: Reproductive systems gametes banate hain aur unhein fertilization ke liye tayyar karte hain.
Mardana system gametes ko zanana system tak pohanchata hai; zanana system fertilized anday ko ghiza aur nashonuma ka mahol deta hai.
Yeh system mard aur aurat mein mukhtalif hai aur puberty tak kaam nahin karta.
